task.title: The contacts page of your own site
task.description: Make contact.html for your own club, study group or library (not Aziz's portfolio): a complete head with viewport and description; a #main link and main id="main"; a header with a menu to index.html, about.html, projects.html, contact.html; one h1; a table with caption and scope col/row; a form with method="get", fieldset, legend, two labelled fields (one email) and button type="submit"; footer.
task.starter_code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <!-- viewport, title, description -->
</head>
<body>
    <!-- "Skip to main content" link -->
    <!-- header with a menu: index.html, about.html, projects.html, contact.html -->
    <!-- main id="main": h1, table (caption, scope col and row), form (fieldset, legend, 2 fields with label, one email, button submit) -->
    <!-- footer -->
</body>
</html>
hints: In head: charset, viewport, your own title and description.
The first line of body: Skip to main content; main gets id="main".
A menu of 4 pages: index.html, about.html, projects.html, contact.html.
Table: caption, th scope="col" in the header row, th scope="row" at the start of rows.
Form: method="get", fieldset + legend, label for = id, type="email", <button type="submit">.
Your own topic: a club, study group, library. Do not copy the sample text.
